name: b2-mcp
description: Official Backblaze B2 MCP server for buckets, files, keys, Object Lock, and S3 storage.

b2_application_key_id.title: Application Key ID
b2_application_key_id.description: Backblaze B2 application key ID (use a non-master application key).

b2_region.title: Region (optional)
b2_region.description: Optional fallback S3-compatible region used before authorization (for example us-east-005).

b2_master_key_id.title: Master Key ID (optional)
b2_master_key_id.description: Optional master key ID, required only for the Partner/Groups API tools.

b2_master_key.title: Master Key (optional)
b2_master_key.description: Optional master key secret, required only for the Partner/Groups API tools.
